newsitem.title: IRAQ: Tunisian minister in Iraq for trade deals.
newsitem.headline: Tunisian minister in Iraq for trade deals.

text.p: Tunisian Transport Minister Sadok Rabeh has arrived in Baghdad at the head of a big trade delegation, the ruling Baath party newspaper al-Thawra said on Friday.
"The Tunisian minister stressed the importance of consolidating cooperation among Arab countries in the face of dangers threatening the Arab nation," the newspaper said.

It said Rabeh would meet senior Iraqi officials in the ministries of trade, transport and communications and industry and minerals. Representatives of a number of Tunisian food and drug companies are accompanying the minister, Thawra said.

Iraq is under stringent trade sanctions for invading Kuwait in 1990. Supplies of a humanitarian nature are not covered by the trade embargo and the country's oil deal with the U.N. signed in May will provide it with $1.13 billion of the $2 billion worth of partial crude sales permitted over six months.
